offline.offlineSubtitle: Zero-internet survival tools, direct GSM cellular calling, and standardized SMS distress dispatchers.
offline.smsDistressDesc: When 4G/5G data is severed, standard GSM SMS can pass through high network congestion.
offline.survivalDirectivesDesc: Critical instructions that remain active even if all telecommunications fail.
offline.directive1Text: Enable Battery Saver / Low Power Mode, set brightness to minimum, disable Bluetooth and GPS background scanning when not acquiring coordinates.
offline.directive2Text: Use a whistle (3 short blasts indicates SOS) or rhythmically bang on metal pipes/beams. Shouting drains oxygen and can inhale dangerous toxic particulates.
offline.directive3Text: Boil water for at least 1 full minute if power is available. Store potable drinking water in sealed containers; avoid tap water if flood inundation occurs.
offline.directive4Text: If you smell sulfur/gas, DO NOT operate light switches or match flames. Shut off main gas valves and evacuate immediately into open air.
offline.ambulanceDesc: Immediate emergency medical transport and paramedic evacuation.
